name: Orion Breweries, Ltd.
summary: Orion Breweries, Ltd. manufactures and sells alcohol and soft drinks in Japan. The company also engages in the operation of hotels and facilities. In addition, it owns, rents, and manages tourist properties. It sells its beer under the Orion brand name. The company was formerly known as Okinawa Breweries, Ltd. and changed its name to Orion Breweries, Ltd. In January 1959. The company was incorporated in 1957 and is headquartered in Tomigusuku, Japan.
